description: Manual / exploratory prompts for streamlit-coco tool display cards and HITL interactions (see doc/features/tools-display/SPEC.md).

prompts.title: Glob — bordered card + path list
prompts.prompt: Use Glob only with pattern `streamlit_coco/*.py`. List every match. Do not Read files.
prompts.notes: Expect Glob card with pattern in header and bullet path list — not a JSON expander.

prompts.title: Glob — nested package files
prompts.prompt: Glob `doc/**/*.md` and report how many markdown docs you found (count + first 5 paths).

prompts.title: Glob — unlikely pattern
prompts.prompt: Glob for `**/*.definitely_does_not_exist_xyz`. Report that there were no matches (or list them if any).
prompts.notes: Card should show pattern and empty/no-matches state cleanly.

prompts.title: Grep — pattern + matches card
prompts.prompt: Use Grep to search for `CocoSession` under `streamlit_coco/`. Show up to 8 matching lines with file paths.

prompts.title: Grep — TODO/FIXME
prompts.prompt: Grep the repo for TODO or FIXME (case insensitive if supported). Cap at 10 matches and summarize.

prompts.title: Grep — regex-ish API symbols
prompts.prompt: Grep in `streamlit_coco/` for the string `render_tool_card` or `tool_family`. Report files that define or import them.

prompts.title: Read — README card
prompts.prompt: Read `README.md` and summarize streamlit-coco in at most 4 sentences.
prompts.notes: Expect Read card with path + content preview code block.

prompts.title: Read — Python module
prompts.prompt: Read `streamlit_coco/tool_names.py` and list the ToolFamily enum members as bullets.

prompts.title: Read — pyproject.toml
prompts.prompt: Read `pyproject.toml` and report package name, version, and requires-python.

prompts.title: Write — approval preview card
prompts.prompt: Write a new file `tmp/coco_display_write.md` containing exactly two lines: `# CoCo probe` and `written for tools-display tests`. Do not write elsewhere.
prompts.notes: Approval UI should show path + content preview (code), not raw JSON. Default demo: Write requires approval.

prompts.title: Write — JSON file preview
prompts.prompt: Write `tmp/coco_display_write.json` with content `{"ok": true, "source": "tools-display"}` only.

prompts.title: Write — exercise Deny
prompts.prompt: Attempt to Write `tmp/coco_should_be_denied.txt` with the text `deny me`. I will Deny in the UI; after denial, acknowledge and stop.
prompts.notes: Click Deny; card/approval should clear without creating the file.

prompts.title: Edit — Before/After approval
prompts.prompt: If `tmp/coco_display_write.md` exists, Edit it to append a third line: `edited for tools-display`. If missing, say so and stop without Write.
prompts.notes: Run after display-write-approval. Approval should show Before and After code blocks.

prompts.title: Edit — small token change
prompts.prompt: If `tmp/coco_display_write.md` exists, Edit the first heading from `# CoCo probe` to `# CoCo display probe`. Otherwise stop.

prompts.title: Bash — command card + approve
prompts.prompt: Run Bash: `pwd && ls -la | head -n 15`. Do not modify files.
prompts.notes: Approval and transcript should show the command in a bash code block.

prompts.title: Bash — echo output
prompts.prompt: Run Bash: `echo 'tools-display-ok' && date`. Read-only; no file changes.

prompts.title: Bash — dangerous Deny UX
prompts.prompt: Request Bash `rm -rf /tmp/coco_should_not_delete`. Explain the risk first. I will Deny.
prompts.notes: Deny in UI; command must not run.

prompts.title: SQL — code + result card
prompts.prompt: Using the SQL tool, run a simple context query (e.g. current warehouse/database/schema or `SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP()`). Then summarize in one sentence.
prompts.notes: Enable SQL in sidebar (auto or approval). Expect SQL code block + table/text result — not JSON expander.

prompts.title: SQL — list tables
prompts.prompt: Use SQL to list up to 10 tables visible to this role (INFORMATION_SCHEMA or SHOW TABLES as appropriate). If blocked, explain clearly.

prompts.title: SQL — approval with query preview
prompts.prompt: Run SQL: `SELECT 1 AS tools_display_probe`. Keep it exactly that simple.
prompts.notes: Put SQL in Requires approval (not auto). Approval UI must show the SQL code, not only the tool name.

prompts.title: SQL — ask before choosing table
prompts.prompt: I want a null-rate profile for a table. If the target table is unclear, use AskUserQuestion (or ask) before any SQL. Do not invent table names.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — single choice
prompts.prompt: Before doing anything else, use AskUserQuestion with header `Refactor scope` and question `What kind of refactor do you want for the permissions module?` Options: (A) Comments only, (B) Rename helpers, (C) Full restructuring. Wait for my answer, confirm it, do not edit files.
prompts.notes: Expect radio + Other… + Submit answers / Cancel — not Approve once.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — use Other…
prompts.prompt: Use AskUserQuestion to ask which output format I prefer for a report: Markdown, CSV, or HTML. I will pick Other… and type a custom format — wait for that and confirm.
prompts.notes: Select Other…, type custom text; Submit stays disabled until the field is filled.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — multiSelect
prompts.prompt: Use AskUserQuestion with multiSelect true asking which areas to review: Docs, Tests, UX, Permissions. Wait for my selection(s), then list them back. No file edits.
prompts.notes: Expect multiselect UI; Other… still available.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — two questions
prompts.prompt: Call AskUserQuestion once with exactly two questions: (1) preferred tone: Concise vs Detailed; (2) include examples: Yes vs No. Wait for both answers, then confirm. No tools other than AskUserQuestion.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — Cancel
prompts.prompt: Use AskUserQuestion to ask whether to proceed with a repo cleanup (Yes / No). I will press Cancel in the UI; then acknowledge cancellation.
prompts.notes: Click Cancel; agent should see denial and stop destructive work.

prompts.title: ExitPlanMode — approve plan UI
prompts.prompt: You are in plan mode. Propose a short plan to add `tmp/coco_plan_note.md` with one sentence of content. When ready, call ExitPlanMode with the plan text and wait for approval. Do not Write until the plan is approved.
prompts.notes: Enable Plan mode in the chat sidebar first. Expect Reject plan / Approve plan (not Always allow).

prompts.title: ExitPlanMode — reject with feedback
prompts.prompt: In plan mode, propose a plan that deliberately omits any verification step, then ExitPlanMode. I will Reject with feedback asking for a verification step.
prompts.notes: Reject with feedback text; agent should revise and ask again.

prompts.title: Mixed — Glob then Read cards
prompts.prompt: Glob `examples/*.py`, then Read `examples/chat_app.py`, and list the sidebar control keys you see in that file.

prompts.title: Mixed — auto Glob then Write approval
prompts.prompt: 1) Glob `examples/*.py` (should auto-run). 2) Write `tmp/coco_mixed_display.txt` listing those filenames, one per line (should ask approval).

prompts.title: Debug — raw tool payload expander
prompts.prompt: Read `streamlit_coco/debug.py` and quote the function that detects debug mode.
prompts.notes: Turn ON CoCo debug mode in the sidebar first. Under the Read card, a collapsed Raw tool payload expander should appear.

prompts.title: Glob — list Python files
prompts.prompt: Using Glob only, list all `**/*.py` files under the current working directory. Summarize the top-level layout in 3 bullets.

prompts.title: Grep — search TODOs
prompts.prompt: Use Grep to find TODO or FIXME comments in this repo. Report file paths and a one-line snippet for each match (max 10).

prompts.title: Read — README summary
prompts.prompt: Read `README.md` and give a short summary of what streamlit-coco is for, in at most 5 sentences.

prompts.title: Multi-tool explore (Glob + Read)
prompts.prompt: Explore this project: Glob for `streamlit_coco/**/*.py`, then Read `streamlit_coco/__init__.py`, and list the public API exports with a one-line description each.

prompts.title: Write — should pause for approval
prompts.prompt: Create a new file `tmp/coco_probe_note.md` with a short markdown note that says this was written by CoCo as a probe. Do not write anywhere else.
prompts.notes: With default demo settings, Write requires Approve / Deny / Always allow.

prompts.title: Edit — should pause for approval
prompts.prompt: If `tmp/coco_probe_note.md` exists, Edit it to append a second line: `edited by CoCo`. If it does not exist, say so and stop without creating it.
prompts.notes: Run after write-approval, or expect a no-op explanation.

prompts.title: Bash — should pause for approval
prompts.prompt: Run a safe Bash command: `pwd && ls -la | head -n 20`. Do not modify any files.

prompts.title: Bash — dangerous (expect deny UX)
prompts.prompt: Propose running `rm -rf /tmp/coco_should_not_delete` via Bash. Explain the risk first, then request the tool. I may deny it in the UI.
prompts.notes: Use to exercise Deny and optional reason feedback.

prompts.title: SQL — list schemas/tables
prompts.prompt: Using the SQL tool, show the current warehouse/database/schema context if available, then list up to 10 tables the role can see. If SQL is not allowed, explain what permission is missing.
prompts.notes: Add SQL to auto-allowed or approval tools in the sidebar first.

prompts.title: SQL — profile a table (ask if unclear)
prompts.prompt: I want a null-rate profile for a table. If you are not sure which table to use, ask me to choose one before running SQL. Do not invent table names.

prompts.title: AskUserQuestion — multiple choice
prompts.prompt: Before doing anything else, use AskUserQuestion to ask me which refactor style I want for the permissions module, with exactly these three options: (A) Comments only, (B) Rename helpers, (C) Full restructuring. Wait for my answer, then briefly confirm the choice. Do not edit files yet.
prompts.notes: Expect the native question UI (radio + Submit answers), not a raw JSON tool expander.

prompts.title: Ambiguous ask — should clarify
prompts.prompt: Fix the bug in the file. Do not guess which file — ask me which path and what symptom I see first.

prompts.title: Scope choice — ask before acting
prompts.prompt: Refactor the permissions module for clarity. Before editing anything, ask whether I want (A) comments only, (B) rename helpers, or (C) full restructuring — and wait for my answer.
prompts.notes: Should surface AskUserQuestion as radio options + Submit answers.

prompts.title: Plan then confirm before Write
prompts.prompt: Propose a plan to add a `examples/testdata/README.md` describing the test prompts dataset. Show the planned file contents in chat, then ask for explicit confirmation before any Write/Edit.

prompts.title: Always allow — second Write
prompts.prompt: Write `tmp/coco_always_allow_a.txt` with the text `first`. After that succeeds, we will send a follow-up for a second write to exercise Always allow.
prompts.notes: Approve with Always allow Write, then send always-allow-followup.

prompts.title: Always allow — follow-up Write
prompts.prompt: Write `tmp/coco_always_allow_b.txt` with the text `second`. If Write was set to Always allow, this should not prompt again.
prompts.notes: Pair with always-allow-path.

prompts.title: Long streamed answer
prompts.prompt: Without using tools, explain how Streamlit fragments interact with a background CoCo agent loop. Use clear sections and aim for a detailed answer (roughly 400–600 words).

prompts.title: Long tool loop (try Stop)
prompts.prompt: Slowly explore this repo: Glob `**/*`, then Read several key files one by one (pyproject.toml, README.md, and two Python modules), narrating as you go. I may press Stop mid-run.
prompts.notes: Use Stop CoCo while running to test cancel UX.

prompts.title: Ask for structured JSON in the reply
prompts.prompt: Inspect `pyproject.toml` (Read it) and reply with a JSON object only, shaped like: {"name": string, "version": string, "requires_python": string, "dependencies": string[]}. No markdown fences.

prompts.title: Multi-turn setup
prompts.prompt: Remember for this session that our focus package is `streamlit_coco` and our preferred style is concise bullet points. Confirm you will follow that, then Glob `streamlit_coco/*.py` and list filenames only.

prompts.title: Multi-turn follow-up
prompts.prompt: Using the package focus we agreed, Read `streamlit_coco/session.py` and summarize CocoRunStatus values as bullets.
prompts.notes: Send after multi-turn-setup.

prompts.title: Request a tool that may be denied
prompts.prompt: Try to use a tool that is not in the current allow-list if possible. If blocked, explain clearly which tool was denied and what the user should enable in the sidebar.
prompts.notes: Works best when allow-list is narrow (e.g. only Read/Glob/Grep).

prompts.title: Mixed chain — auto then approval
prompts.prompt: 1) Glob for `examples/*.py` (should auto-run). 2) Then Write `tmp/coco_mixed_chain.txt` listing those example filenames (should ask approval). Keep the write minimal.
